paite: Nang zaw thuhilhna hoih toh kituak thu gen in.
heading: Sinsak Ding Tuamtuamte
english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

paite: Putekte kidek thei, zahtakhuai, lungsim hoihtak, ginna leh itna leh kuhkalna a diktak hi ding in hanthawn in.
english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

paite: Pitekte leng huchibang in, sianthouna toh kimeh, khohei a zahdan siam ding leh heh hat lou, uain hai lou, thil hoihte zilsakte hi zaw ding in hanthawn in.
english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

paite: Nungak deuhte tuh apasalte uh leh atate uh it ding leh lungsim hoihtak pu a om ding a ahilhtheihna ding un,
english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

paite: Pathian thu gensiat a a-omlouhna ding in theisiamtak a kithunun thei, beven lou, amau insung kem hiathiat, chingkam leh apasalte thuthu a om ding a athuhilh theihna ding in.
english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

paite: Huai bang in, tangvalte lungsim hoihtak pu ding in hasuan in.
english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

paite: Thil bangkim a thil hoih hih lam a etton ding in kibawl inla; na thugin sinsakna ah diktatna, chihtakna leh,
english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

paite: gensiat vual louh paukamte langsak lechin alehlam a nang hon demte'n nang tungtang thu a thusia gen ding nei lou a azumtheihna ding un.
english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

paite: Sikhate, apute uh sel lou a athuthu a om ding leh bangkim a akipahna ding ua om ding in thuhilh in.
english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

paite: Pathian i hondampa thuhilhna thu bangkim a akilawmsak theihna ding un, khut them nei lou ding, muanhuai a nna hoih tengteng hihlang zaw ding in sinsak in.
english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

paite: Mi tengteng kiang ah hotdamna hon tun in i Pathian hehpihna ahong tungta hi.
heading: Lametna Kipahhuai
english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

paite: Pathian limsaklouhna leh khovel duhgawlna tawpsan in, tulai khovel ah kidek leh diktattak leh Pathian limsak in i om ding uh chih theisak in.
english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

paite: Lametna kipahhuai, i Pathian thupi leh Hondampa Jesu Khrist thupina kilakna ngak in.
english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

paite: Ama'n tatlekna tengteng lak a kipan in ahon tattheihna ding in leh chitel tuam, thil hoih hih a phatuamngai, amah a ding a ahihsiangthou theihna ding in i sik in akipeta hi.
english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

paite: Thuneitak in huai thute hilh inla, hanthawn inla, taihilh in. Kuamah in nang hon musit kei uhen.
english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.
